proposed.explanation: Given your 3-month horizon, low willingness and financial ability to withstand losses, and immediate requirement for 10,000 EGP cash for a family wedding, selling your entire holding of 200 shares of EFID at 20.40 EGP per share is recommended. Selling 200 shares yields 4,080.00 EGP in cash, increasing your cash balance from 1,000.00 EGP to 5,080.00 EGP. Although EFID showed strong fundamental performance in 2025 with consolidated net profit growing to 2,695,301,670 EGP from 1,606,727,698 EGP in 2024, consolidated revenue increasing to 20,915,072,432 EGP from 16,146,545,699 EGP, and EPS rising to 2.18 EGP from 1.09 EGP, holding equity over a 3-month period poses short-term market risk that conflicts with your capital preservation need. Note that even after liquidating all shares, total cash reaches 5,080.00 EGP, leaving a shortfall against your 10,000 EGP goal that must be addressed through external funds.
